source_name: MERSIS — Central Registry System (Ministry of Trade)
rate_limits: free per-company query (MERSIS no / VKN / title); no open bulk/API
notes: The central company registry. Every company has a 16-digit MERSIS number; holds title (unvan), VKN (tax id), trade-registry number, NACE activity, address, type, status. Free per-company query (JS form); NO open bulk/API. Cataloged from public docs / query model.

source_name: Türkiye Ticaret Sicili Gazetesi — Trade Registry Gazette
organization: TOBB (Union of Chambers and Commodity Exchanges)
notes: The official gazette publishing company registrations, amendments, and dissolutions (kuruluş/değişiklik/tasfiye). Searchable per company / trade-registry number. The source of company events/announcements; no open bulk. Free.

source_name: KAP — Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu (Public Disclosure Platform)
notes: The Public Disclosure Platform for LISTED companies (Borsa İstanbul). Member list + per-company pages (/tr/sirket-bilgileri/ozet/{kapId}-{slug}) + financial statements (mali tablolar) and disclosures, public. Verified live: 808 listed companies extracted (e.g. ADEL KALEMCILIK 832, Yapı Kredi Bankası 2429). Listed only; private financials not public.

The Revenue Administration provides VKN (tax number) verification / VAT (KDV) taxpayer lookup per company. The VKN is the tax id (no separate VAT number). Per-company lookup; no open bulk. Cataloged from public docs.
